mapper.select: SELECT u.admin_user_id, u.login_id, u.display_name, u.organization_unit_id, u.password_hash, u.account_status, u.consecutive_failures, u.locked_until, u.must_change_password, u.last_login_at, u.version_no, r.role_code, p.permission_code FROM seal.admin_user u LEFT JOIN seal.user_role ur ON ur.admin_user_id = u.admin_user_id LEFT JOIN seal.admin_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id AND r.active = TRUE LEFT JOIN seal.role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.role_id LEFT JOIN seal.permission p ON p.permission_id = rp.permission_id WHERE u.login_id = #{loginId} ORDER BY r.role_code, p.permission_code

SELECT u.admin_user_id, u.login_id, u.display_name, u.organization_unit_id, u.password_hash, u.account_status, u.consecutive_failures, u.locked_until, u.must_change_password, u.last_login_at, u.version_no, r.role_code, p.permission_code FROM seal.admin_user u LEFT JOIN seal.user_role ur ON ur.admin_user_id = u.admin_user_id LEFT JOIN seal.admin_role r ON r.role_id = ur.role_id AND r.active = TRUE LEFT JOIN seal.role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.role_id LEFT JOIN seal.permission p ON p.permission_id = rp.permission_id WHERE u.admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} ORDER BY r.role_code, p.permission_code
mapper.update: UPDATE seal.admin_user SET consecutive_failures = #{consecutiveFailures}, locked_until = #{lockedUntil, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} AND version_no = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE seal.admin_user SET consecutive_failures = 0, locked_until = NULL, last_login_at = #{loggedInAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} AND version_no = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE seal.admin_user SET password_hash = #{passwordHash}, must_change_password = #{mustChangePassword}, consecutive_failures = 0, locked_until = NULL, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{adminUserId}, version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE admin_user_id = #{adminUserId} AND version_no = #{expectedVersion}
